issue.title: Evaluate a Salvage & Commit recovery action for hijacked agents
issue.description:
Proposed by land phase sase-1qz.11 (note #5) of epic sase-1qz (Agent Hijack, plan:202611/agent_hijack.md), which deferred "Salvage & Commit".

Recovery actions today either keep the work in the held workspace for a successor (Escalate/Continue/Instruct) or snapshot and release it (Restart/Edit/Dismiss). Neither lets the user keep the stalled agent's partial work as a commit without running another agent turn. Shape: evaluate a recovery action that commits the hijacked turn's changes across the primary and linked repos through the host-owned finalizer path (agents never commit), then releases the workspace, so partial progress lands without a successor.

task_type_fields.proposal: Add a recovery action that commits a hijacked turn's changes across primary and linked repos through host-owned finalizers, then releases the workspace, so partial progress lands without a successor turn.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: The hijack epic scoped recovery to keep-work successors and snapshot-gated release; committing salvaged work touches host completion and was explicitly deferred.

issue.creation_reason: Epic sase-1qz's land phase (sase-1qz.11) deferred Salvage & Commit; today partial hijacked work can only be continued by a successor or snapshotted and released.
